artifact_observations.location: Front sight post / Gas block area
artifact_observations.reasoning: The front sight assembly appears slightly fused with the barrel. The vertical post lacks a distinct, sharp separation from the horizontal gas block ring, suggesting minor geometric melting or generation ambiguity.
The horizontal reinforcing ribs on the curved magazine fade out inconsistently towards the bottom curve, lacking the precise mechanical uniformity expected of stamped steel.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific taxonomy (AK-pattern vs AR-pattern) and verify class alignment.
To verify the cylindrical integrity of the barrel and ensure the magazine is physically grounded in the receiver without floating.
To check for boundary bleeding between the trigger guard loop and the pistol grip/receiver, a common failure point in AI gun generation.
To assess overall sharpness and detect subtle texture inconsistencies in the matte finish.

focus_areas: Connection point of magazine to receiver (magwell)
Structural integrity of the front sight post
Continuity of the trigger guard loop
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the front sight assembly; AI often struggles with the thin vertical post connecting to the barrel. Verify if the magazine curves naturally or if the geometry warps unnaturally near the tip. Check if the trigger guard is a closed loop or if it merges incorrectly with the grip.
